name: Marrow animated wallpapers

host.signature: vec3 wall(vec2 p, float t) returns sRGB in 0..1; the host adds the dither
host.coordinates: p = (fragCoord - 0.5 * resolution) * (2 / resolution.y), y up: the height spans -1..1 and x grows with the aspect
host.clock: t is the loop clock in seconds, 0 <= t < T (period). The host keeps a phase per wallpaper, phase += dt * speed, wrapped at T; changing the speed never moves the picture. All motion is built from a = TAU * t / T, its whole-number multiples and closed loops in noise space, so frame(t) == frame(t + T).

uniforms.name: u_pal
uniforms.meaning: the colour pack in OKLab: the host mixes the pack’s dark and light palettes for the theme, and eases from the old palette to the new on a pack or theme change (time constant 0.25 s)

uniforms.name: u_dark
uniforms.meaning: 0 light .. 1 dark, eased with the same time constant

uniforms.name: u_opt
uniforms.meaning: x = Motion (0 calm .. 1 lively), y = the wallpaper’s second option (0..1), each eased (0.3 s)

uniforms.name: u_px
uniforms.meaning: one device pixel in p units, 2 / resolution.y, for anti-aliased edges

host.dither: triangular, one 8-bit step, fixed in screen space: (ign(fc) + ign(fc + (37, 17)) - 1) / 255 with ign(v) = fract(52.9829189 * fract(dot(v, (0.06711056, 0.00583715))))
host.subset: GLSL ES 3.00 written to the SkSL runtime-effect subset: math only, no textures, no derivatives, no preprocessor, for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) loops only, no bit operations or integer modulo, uniform arrays indexed by loop indices only. Each file is checked against this list when the library is built.
host.speed: Speed is per wallpaper, 0.25x to 2.5x, default 1x. It scales the phase clock only; easing it (0.18 s) keeps a change smooth.

wallpapers.name: Borealis
wallpapers.desc: Curtains of aurora over a night sky, rays shimmering up from a bright foot.

wallpapers.name: Molten
wallpapers.desc: Drops of liquid chrome drifting, merging and parting, mirroring a bright studio.

wallpapers.name: Velvet
wallpapers.desc: Folds of heavy satin, jewel-dark in the shadows, with a sheen along every fold.

wallpapers.name: Spectra
wallpapers.desc: A glass prism turning in a white beam, its spectrum sweeping through the haze.

wallpapers.name: Bloom
wallpapers.desc: A flower made of light: two rings of translucent petals sway and breathe.

wallpapers.name: Nebula
wallpapers.desc: Glowing gas folded by slow currents, crossed by dark dust and a few still stars.

wallpapers.name: Lagoon
wallpapers.desc: Sunlight focused by moving water onto a shallow floor, each line edged with colour.

wallpapers.name: Iris
wallpapers.desc: A soap film turning slowly, its colours true thin-film interference.

wallpapers.name: Dunes
wallpapers.desc: Ridge after ridge of sand under a low sun; the light slides across the faces.

wallpapers.name: Tides
wallpapers.desc: Five broad waves of colour laid one over another, rolling slowly.

wallpapers.name: Afterglow
wallpapers.desc: Warm light leaking in at the edges, as on a roll of film, swelling and fading.

wallpapers.name: Inkwell
wallpapers.desc: Two inks dropped into still water, billowing into fine tendrils.

wallpapers.name: Fluted
wallpapers.desc: Colour drifting behind a pane of reeded glass; the glass stays still.

wallpapers.name: Meridian
wallpapers.desc: A slow-turning gradient of five colours, melting toward a soft light.

wallpapers.name: Nacre
wallpapers.desc: Mother of pearl: thin layers that catch the light and shift hue as they drift.

wallpapers.name: Ribbon
wallpapers.desc: Two satin ribbons floating across the window, twisting slowly as they go.

wallpapers.name: Mist
wallpapers.desc: Coloured mist in four layers at different depths, the near veils sliding over the far.

wallpapers.name: Daybreak
wallpapers.desc: A quiet horizon at first light, a low sun resting on still water.

wallpapers.name: Stillwater
wallpapers.desc: The light of a pool thrown softly onto a pale wall, never sharp.

wallpapers.name: Linen
wallpapers.desc: A woven linen breathing in a faint draught, its threads catching the light.

wallpapers.name: Fields
wallpapers.desc: Three soft fields of colour floating on a ground, breathing very slowly.

wallpapers.name: Lumen
wallpapers.desc: A shaft of sunlight sweeping slowly across a wall, a soft caustic wavering in it.

wallpapers.name: Drift
wallpapers.desc: Banks of coloured fog lying one behind another, rising and settling.

wallpapers.name: Halo
wallpapers.desc: One wide, soft ring of light, its colour turning slowly round it.
